brief.text: Morning. The big one is Gabriel Jesus, whose new agent was spotted meeting Napoli yesterday, though the agent insists he was only there to see Allegri, so file that under "developing but messy" until someone shows a bid. Arsenal will only sanction a permanent exit, and Napoli need to shift Lukaku before they can even talk numbers. Elsewhere, the Bruno Guimaraes saga has real legs with Newcastle publicly demanding a "higher number" and both clubs apparently keen to keep the bonus clauses quiet, while Callum Wilson reckons an emotional Bruno genuinely wanted the move. Everything else in the pile, the £73m Vinicius alternative, the Barcola hijack, the Alvarez dream window, is classic deadline-season fan fiction from the rumour mill, so enjoy it but don't book the parade. On a serious note, the FA has banned perimeter walls around pitches following Billy Vigar's death, and Declan Rice has responded publicly to a teammate's confirmed ACL injury.

clusters.title: 🚨 FA statement on Chelsea. "A financial sanction of £10 million and a suspended two-window registration ban have been imposed on Chelsea FC for breaches of The Football Association [The FA] Football Agent Regulations, Regulations on Working with Intermediaries and Third Party Investment in Players Regulations. "The FA charged Chelsea FC with 74 breaches of FA Rule E1.2 after its current ownership self-reported misconduct upon its purchase of the club. The FA is continuing to investigate individual misconduct arising out of this case. "Chelsea FC admitted to the 74 breaches of FA Rule E1.2 prior to a hearing and an independent Regulatory Commission imposed a six-point deduction, which was to be suspended until 30 June 2027, and a £10 million fine. "The club appealed against the suspended points deduction and an independent Appeal Board allowed the appeal and set aside this sanction following a further hearing. In its place, the Appeal Board imposed a registration ban for two complete and consecutive transfer windows which is suspended until 30 June 2027. "The £10 million fine imposed by the Regulatory Commission was not subject to appeal and the full amount will be invested into grassroots football."

Attributing a political meaning to that collaboration means attributing to me beliefs that I have never expressed and that do not belong to me. I wish to thank Maldini and Leonardo for the esteem and trust they have shown me. I know their competence, their seriousness, and the love they have always dedicated to Italian football. I regret that a purely sporting choice was so quickly dragged into a public confrontation that ended up attributing to me meanings and intentions that do not belong to me. Love for Italy does not depend on a job title. It is part of my history, of my identity, and it will continue to accompany me, always.

"At 13:22 a response communication was sent to the German club with which, while reiterating that it was a matter of detailed changes with respect to the structure of the deal, understanding the technical needs of the German club, SSC Napoli would have been available to accept the version of the contract as proposed by Schalke".
